replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
You should add more structures onto the map. The trees make it stale and look boring. Try to also use unique shapes instead of cuboids. This will make your map pop out more and look unique. Another suggestion would be to add more space for pvp/building. There doesn't seem to be much space bedside of the trees. Maybe some more open areas? Also, I suggest making some elevation onto the top floors. Maybe hills that move slightly up with a tower at the top and depressions in the grass that go down to lower levels like a cave system. It's not a bad start but if you want to submit this map, you'll have to make it unique and stand out from other maps.

tl;dr
Add more structures and not trees
Make it less flat
Add more space to the map
